column1: # 60-everyday-makers.tsv: private vaults, one mouse for two computers, game streaming, makers' tools, notes and money apps (ideas 69, 74, 75, 76, 77, 81).
# Columns (TAB separated): id kind title plain_description approx_size_mb profiles default arch idea
# Every flatpak id was checked live on Flathub (API appstream and summary pages) on 2026-11-17, every rpm name on mdapi.fedoraproject.org the same day.
# Evidence: tests/appseveryday/live-checks.tsv. Sizes are Flathub's installed size (rounded); sdrpp (rpm, with its few libraries) is an estimate, not measured.
# Defaults follow the plan: Cryptomator, Xournal++ and HomeBank on; everything else only if chosen. Makers' tools carry " - Makers" in the title.
# Not in this file on purpose:
#   scrcpy (idea 73) is in neither Fedora nor Flathub; secure-linux-phone-backup mirror fetches the maker's own build and checks its SHA-256.
#   Espanso (idea 77) is in neither Fedora nor Flathub (Flathub's espansoGUI is only a settings helper), so it is not offered.

column4: Keeps private files in a locked folder (a vault) that you can sync to any cloud or USB drive. Only you can read what is inside.
Use one keyboard and mouse across two computers on your home network. On the newer Wayland desktop it can be fiddly; the guide explains.
Lets another device on your home network see and control this computer's screen, for example to play games from the couch. Opens its ports on the home network only.
Shows a computer running Sunshine on this screen with very little delay, so you can use it from another room. Works with Sunshine.
Design real objects in 3D, such as parts for a 3D printer. Free and powerful. A big download.
Draw electronic circuits and design circuit boards. The big library of 3D part pictures is a separate, much larger download.
Turns a 3D model into the steps a 3D printer follows. Works with most printers, not only Prusa.
Another free slicer for 3D printers, with many ready-made printer settings. Pick this or PrusaSlicer, whichever you like.
A well-known free slicer for 3D printers. Flathub does not mark this package as verified by UltiMaker, so choose it only if you want Cura.
Write and send programs to Arduino and similar small boards. Needs an Intel or AMD computer.
Puts the Raspberry Pi system on a memory card. It erases the card you pick, so read the name of the card twice before you press Write.
Listen to the radio spectrum with a cheap USB radio stick (an RTL-SDR). Shows what is on the air as a moving picture. Needs the stick.
Control the coloured lights on your keyboard, memory and case in one place, with no company account.
Write or draw on a page, mark up a PDF, and sign a PDF by drawing your signature. Free and works offline.
Remembers the last things you copied so you can paste an older one again. The full setup already has this built in, so it is offered for lighter setups.
Keep track of your accounts, spending and budget on your own computer. Nothing is sent to a bank or a company.
Full double-entry accounts for a household or a small business. More powerful than HomeBank and harder to learn.
